source.name: Gambling News: Birmingham City Welcomes Entain's Coral as Front-of-Shirt Sponsor in 2026/27
source.quote: Starting from the upcoming season, however, the brand will also have its logo displayed on men’s and women’s shirts.
source.note: The article reports Coral's first front-of-shirt partnership, with the Birmingham City club store selling the sponsored 26/27 home jersey for women (product 2475); its product images show Coral on the front and no sponsor on the sleeves or back, and the 26/27 home shorts images show no sponsor.

summary: Entain's Coral betting brand sits on the front of the Birmingham City Women shirt, its first front-of-shirt deal. The club's own store images of the sponsored 26/27 home shirt (product 2475) and shorts (product 2503) show no sponsor on the sleeves, back or shorts.
